prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE new high-fidelity flat UI specimen board for existing DooKnow notebook sidebar feedback. Seven independent local UI fragments arranged in a clean vertical stack, generous readable width, not seven full windows. Outside each fragment use only a tiny number 1–7 so reviewers can distinguish separate mutually exclusive examples; these numbers are not product controls. No app navigation/header, query inputs, footer, device/browser frame, explanations or invented state headings. Every fragment is an actual narrow sidebar content region, normal readable Chinese type, white/light-gray environment, #272b3a text, #657084 muted, #e6e9f1 border, cobalt #4566c6 and pale #edf1ff accent;8px corner radius only where actual control/alert needs it, flat CSS style with no gradients/raster texture. Keep text and small outlined source buttons readable, and wrap long status text naturally rather than reducing fonts.

Fragment1: only a small animated-dot indication (still illustration is a small blue dot) followed by exact normal status text "正在搜索…". No buttons or alert box.
Fragment2: same small dot and exact normal status text "搜索索引正在更新，请稍候…". No buttons or alert.
Fragment3: only muted paragraph "没有匹配的笔记". No icon, no action button.
Fragment4: normal status paragraph "部分内容搜索或索引尚未准备好，结果可能不完整。" followed by the existing INLINE transparent text button "检查搜索设置". Do not turn it into an error alert, modal, or filled button.
Fragment5: one existing Ant-style ERROR alert region with exact message "内容搜索组件还未准备好，文件名搜索仍可使用。". It has NO show-icon or close X. Immediately below, two small neutral OUTLINED buttons side by side in this exact order: "重试搜索" and "检查搜索设置". No added dismiss/reload/OK action.
Fragment6: muted actual count paragraph "已显示 3 项", then one neutral outlined button "加载更多搜索结果". This is a separate valid nonbusy/nonerror pagination example, not a global or numbered page navigator. Full result cards live on a separate page and must not be redrawn here; no spinner, no total-count invention.
Fragment7: simple muted paragraph "目录暂时无法读取" and below one small neutral outlined button "重新加载目录". This is the SIDEBAR div fragment, not the main unavailable landing: no folder illustration, heading, additional explanatory text, retry connection button or red alert.

Keep each numbered region independent, visibly separated only by external board spacing/thin neutral comparison guides, not a new application card workflow. Never blend1–7 into one simultaneous product state. No search-submit, filter, native chooser, owner rail, private content, API/code/role metadata or English labels. Preserve all exact Chinese punctuation and button labels. One crisp illustrative board, taller if necessary to show seven legible fragments; do not crop any controls.
